speaker: Samantha
text: Long-term unemployment was at record levels. Modest payments of unemployment benefits were a lifeline that enabled people who were out of work to maintain at least an appearance of normalcy, keeping a roof over their heads, putting gas in their cars, and paying electric and phone bills.
